_: Named views for scripts/shot.mjs --view <name> and scripts/compare.mjs. Coordinates are scene metres: x east, y up, z south of the middle of cầu Trường Tiền; the river is at y 0 and the city's ground at y 2.6 (LAND_Y). A view is either a fixed camera (camera: { pos, target }) or an arrival: the camera starts at start, the visitor's pick of place runs (the same call a search result or a label makes), and frames are taken that many seconds into it. viewport is CSS pixels at device scale 1; look real|ink; time 0 morning, 1 afternoon, 2 evening; reducedMotion emulates prefers-reduced-motion. Add a view when a task needs one; change an existing view only on purpose, since earlier captures stop being comparable.

ngo-mon-arrival.note: A visitor over Trường Tiền searches for Ngọ Môn and flies there; landscape desktop window.

truong-tien-river-level.note: Cầu Trường Tiền from a boat on the Hương, downstream (east) of the bridge, looking upstream.

junction-west-lanes.note: A junction west of the citadel's south-east corner, from above at an angle: lane markings, medians and pavement where four roads meet.

junction-bridge-west.note: Straight down on the brick bridge over the citadel moat at x -464, z -49, where its deck meets the street.

junction-phu-xuan-south.note: Straight down on the south end of cầu Phú Xuân, where the bridge, Hà Nội and Lê Lợi meet, with the slip roads between them (issue #67).

junction-phu-xuan-north.note: Straight down on the north end of cầu Phú Xuân, where the bridge meets Trần Hưng Đạo and Lê Duẩn (issue #67).

junction-truong-tien-north.note: Straight down on the north end of cầu Trường Tiền, where its approach meets Trần Hưng Đạo and Chương Dương (issue #67).

junction-ly-thuong-kiet-ha-noi.note: Straight down on the six-way junction of Lý Thường Kiệt and Hà Nội (issue #67).

junction-phu-xuan-south-oblique.note: The south end of cầu Phú Xuân from above the Hà Nội side, looking north-west across the junction to the bridge (issue #67).

thuong-tu-boat.note: A visitor's report of a boat running through a bridge: above cầu Cửa Thượng Tứ by the Citadel's east corner, where a moored sampan sat under the deck (shared link c=-436.7,48.1,-63.9 t=-458.9,-52.2 a=1.91 f=44.7 m=10r).

courtyard-vac-ta-vu.note: Close view of the bronze cauldron (vạc đồng) before Tả Vu in the Cần Chánh court, from the axis side (src/landmarks/courtyard.js).

courtyard-cannons-quang-duc.note: The five holy cannons (Cửu vị thần công, Ngũ hành) in their house inside Cửa Quảng Đức, from in front of the muzzles (src/landmarks/courtyard.js).

courtyard-cannons-the-nhon.note: The four holy cannons (Cửu vị thần công, Tứ thời) in their house inside Cửa Thể Nhơn, from in front of the muzzles (src/landmarks/courtyard.js).

thaihoa-kylan-front.note: The front of điện Thái Hòa from Long Trì just west of the axis: the pair of bronze kỳ lân at the foot of the middle flight and the one vạc on the hall's left, the east (src/landmarks/places/thaihoa.js).

themieu-kylan-kiosk.note: The east bronze kỳ lân of Thế Miếu's court in its metal kiosk (thiết đình), from the walk side (src/landmarks/places/themieu.js).

thaihoa-open-doors.note: Into điện Thái Hòa through the three open middle front bays, from Đan Bệ on the axis: the bronze cranes on tortoises either side of the throne bay (src/landmarks/places/thaihoa.js).

north-bank-pavilion-yard.note: Straight down on the riverside park just west of cầu Trường Tiền's north end: the six-sided pavilion in its ring of path and the paved yards around it (issue #69).

north-bank-pavilion-yard-oblique.note: The same park from the south-east at an angle, as the issue's screenshot sees it.

ngo-mon-dich-mon.note: Standing in Ngọ Môn's forecourt between the wings, at eye height, looking at the west wing's inner face: Tả Dịch Môn and the west Giáp Môn from the side.

ngu-binh-north.note: Núi Ngự Bình from the north, over the An Cựu quarter, looking south along the Citadel's axis at the flat top.

dcct-front.note: Nhà thờ Dòng Chúa Cứu Thế from the forecourt, about 70 m east of the front, matched to VietNamNet's front photograph (the stepped gable, the great window, the canopy).

dcct-aerial.note: Nhà thờ Dòng Chúa Cứu Thế from a drone over the crossroads east of the grounds, matched to VietNamNet's aerial (the front block and the crossing tower behind).

phucam-front.note: Phủ Cam from 20 m above the forecourt stair, about 50 m in front on the axis, matched to the Commons 2024 front photographs (the towers, the shoulders, the nave gable behind).

phucam-aerial.note: Phủ Cam from above Đoàn Hữu Trưng, 170 m in front on the axis, looking down on the front and the cross plan.

citadel-west-moat.note: The citadel's west face around cửa Chánh Tây, from outside above Lê Duẩn: the moat (Hộ Thành Hào) between Tây Thành Đài and Tây Thành Thủy Quan, crossed by cầu Chánh Tây.

elevation-ga-hue-street.note: Ga Huế's forecourt and the streets east of it from just above the rooftops (issue #73): houses, roads and the station seated on the raised plain south of the river.

elevation-south-plain.note: The plain between Ga Huế and An Cựu from 120 m, looking north-west towards the river (issue #73): the half-metre swells of the elevation raster under the streets and houses.

elevation-tombs-far.note: The hills of the tombs from high over the city's south-west, looking south-west past lăng Tự Đức and Đồng Khánh towards Thiệu Trị (issue #73).

junction-phu-xuan-south-slip.note: Close above the south end of cầu Phú Xuân, where slip road 1169319990 joins Hà Nội eastbound and the traffic island between them carries a tree (PR #80's leftovers).

junction-trees-west.note: Straight down on a junction patch west of the Citadel (x −1516, z 1229) where four trees stood on the painted asphalt (PR #80's leftovers).

junction-trees-south.note: Straight down on a junction patch in the south of the city (x −1056, z 2548) where four trees stood on the painted asphalt (PR #80's leftovers).
